info.name: Bulldogs Exchange API
info.description:
Run "Auth → Login as Admin" and "Auth → Register Customer" first. They save the tokens automatically.

Requests use the admin token unless they say (Customer) or (Public).
Products: uses the products already in your database. productId is filled in by "List products". Nothing creates or changes products unless you edit a request body, and "Delete product" only runs after you set deleteProductId.
You can run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Log in first. The token is saved to a collection variable.

exec: // A new email each run, so registering never conflicts

request.description: Activity 4: user management is Admin only.
Activity 4 enhancement: a user may edit their own account. Editing someone else returns 403.

item.name: Products
item.description: Works with the products already in your database. Nothing here creates test products, and running the folder leaves your products unchanged.

request.description: Lists your existing products and remembers one (the first with stock) as productId for the other requests.

item.name: Filter products by category and price (Public)

request.description: Change the category to one of yours.
Activity 3: pagination, filtering by category and supplier, keyword search, and sorting in one request, with the standard { success, message, count, data } response.
Loads the current values of productId so "Update product" can start from them.
Shows that product changes are protected. Nothing is created.
Run "Get product" first. The body re-sends the product's current values, so running it as-is changes nothing. Replace a value (e.g. the price) to really edit it.
Pick an image file for the "image" field to replace the product photo. Other fields re-send the current values. Needs the Cloudinary keys in .env.

exec: // Without a chosen file this would only return "Image file is required.", so skip it
console.log("Skipped: choose an image file in the Body tab to upload one.");

request.description: Pick an image file (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 5 MB) for the "image" field first; it replaces the photo of productId. Skipped when no file is chosen. Needs the Cloudinary keys in .env.

exec: console.log("Skipped: set the deleteProductId collection variable to delete a product.");

request.description: Deletes a real product, so it never runs by accident: set the "deleteProductId" collection variable to the _id of the product you want to delete first. Skipped while it is empty.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Reading is public. Changes need the admin token.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Run "Products → List products" first so productId is set. The order is cancelled at the end, which puts the stock back.

request.description: Only product and quantity are needed. The server looks up the price and reserves stock.

item.name: Place order - more than in stock (Customer)

request.description: Status: pending, processing, ready, shipped, delivered, or cancelled.
Cancelling puts the items back in stock.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: One review per customer per product.

item.name: Carts
item.description: Customers can only see and change their own cart.

request.description: Prices come from the database; any price you send is ignored.

item.name: Suppliers
item.description: Reading is public. Changes need the admin token.

item.name: Audit Logs
item.description: Admin only. Every API request is saved in the logs collection.
